title: Toasts v2 (Settings > Advanced > Experiments > Toasts v2, experiments.toastsV2): one toast starts as a spinner (Running tests…) and turns into its result in its own slot; closing a tab shows one line with an ink Undo, and Undo brings the tab back. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/toasts-v2-promise-undo.json --video

steps.title: Running tests…: the toast leads with a spinner and waits for its result
Tests passed: the same card turns into its result in place, no second toast
2 tests failed: the error result, quiet glass with a red mark
Close it as a person does: one line, Closed “Build logs”, with Undo
Undo, as its button does: the tab comes back
